offering_description.value: Publishes local daily and weekly newspapers along with their websites and mobile apps in mid-sized US markets. Sells print and digital advertising to local businesses and news subscriptions to readers, and also offers commercial printing and marketing services.

primary_products.value: print newspapers; digital news subscriptions; digital advertising; commercial printing

primary_services.value: digital marketing services; commercial printing; direct mail distribution

customer_segment.value: B2B: local retailers, automotive dealers, real estate firms, healthcare providers and other advertisers; B2C: local readers buying print and digital news subscriptions

end_markets.value: local retail; automotive; real estate; healthcare; legal and public notices

revenue_model.value: advertising: print and digital ads sold to local businesses; subscription: print and digital news subscriptions paid by readers; service fees: commercial printing and marketing services for businesses; other: fees for legal and public notice placements

value_chain_position.value: service provider: produces local news and sells audiences and advertising to local businesses and readers; OEM / manufacturer: prints its newspapers and commercial jobs in its own plants, sold to readers and businesses

geography_served.value: US national: dozens of local markets across many states, mainly Midwest, Mountain West and Southeast

specialization.value: related lines: newspapers, digital news and advertising, commercial printing and marketing services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house advertising sales teams selling to local businesses; online: company websites and mobile apps for digital news and subscriptions; third-party retail: newsstands and retail stores selling single copies; other: home delivery of print editions by carriers and mail
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; online; third-party retail; other

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: labor, postal and data privacy rules, state public notice laws for legal advertising
